notes: All 16 chips run gain 3000, +/-20 mT, 63.00 V/T. Read live off both carriers over SPI on 2026-08-19 with 'onbox_gain_config.py show': every chip reports G_CTRL X/Z/Y = [0,0,0], EGain_sel = 0x00, key = 0xa5, valid = True, and each has loaded its own gain-3000 trim set. This file previously said S1-S8 were on +/-40 mT / 34.65 V/T, which was true before the 2026-08-19 harmonisation and stale afterwards -- that error scaled every S1-S8 reading by 1.82x, invisibly, because nothing about a uniformly wrong half looks wrong on screen. If the gain is ever changed again, change these ranges in the same commit. NOTE: eeprom_backup/ holds the PRE-harmonisation dumps (EGain_sel = 0x15, gain 1500, +/-40 mT); 'onbox_gain_config.py restore' would put the probe back to 1500 and silently invalidate these ranges. 'dead' is left empty on purpose: S16's chip is alive over SPI and only its analogue ribbon is faulty, so the GUI detects the fault at run time and will stop excluding it the moment the ribbon is repaired.
